description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's '--ancestry-path' feature. It sets up various commit graphs, runs Git log commands with different '--ancestry-path' options, and verifies the expected commit histories. It also includes tests for complex commit graph scenarios like criss-cross merges.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge of specified branch with '--ours' strategy, commits the merge with a message, and tags the commit.

methods.name: test_ancestry
methods.description: Runs 'git log' with given arguments, compares the output to expected lines, and verifies the ancestry path behavior.
